title: Phase-A exit gate: add -> ask -> cited claim / abstain -> eval green
description: Verification gate for the walking skeleton. DONE when: a scripted 'lode add' of a known note then 'lode ask' returns a cited claim whose quoted_span occurs verbatim in the cited version, an out-of-corpus question ABSTAINS, and 'lode eval' runs green on the deterministic golden fixture. Closing this closes E-skel and unblocks the deepening tasks.
acceptance_criteria: lode add + lode ask yields a verbatim-grounded cited claim on an in-corpus question; an out-of-corpus question abstains; lode eval reports recall@k / faithfulness / abstention on the fixture without error.

title: E-skel — Phase A: walking skeleton (thin end-to-end slice)
description: The thin vertical slice that proves the core loop end-to-end BEFORE any subsystem is deepened (user decision: walking-skeleton-first). Composed of a subset of E0/E1/E3/E4/E5/E6/E9/E10 tickets wired by TICKET-level data deps (the epic-level spine was converted to ticket-level so the slice can flow). Exit gate: 'lode add' a known note, 'lode ask' returns a verifiable cited claim (span occurs verbatim in the cited version) OR an honest abstention, and 'lode eval' runs green on a tiny golden set. In the skeleton: synchronous inline embed (no queue yet), rerank OFF, graph_expand a no-op (no edges yet), faithfulness = verbatim-span + abstain only (no extractive-coupling/NLI), and the no_egress + redact-before-egress gate present for the first live Claude call. Deepening tickets depend on this epic.

title: Deterministic seed-corpus fixture for the eval harness (reproducible version_ids)
description: The golden Q&A set pins known-good citations to content-hash version_ids + verbatim spans (faithfulness schema). Those ids do not exist until notes are saved, and re-save/re-chunk changes them. So commit a FIXED set of input note bodies the harness loads deterministically, yielding reproducible version_ids the golden citations can reference. Unblocks lode-5y8.3 (the golden set is unauthorable without this).

title: Pin local model ids + vector dim; verify fastembed loads embedder/reranker/NLI
description: DECIDE-ONCE + spike. (1) Pin the embedding model id and its VECTOR DIMENSION (build constant; re-key = full re-embed) — LanceDB table creation needs the dim fixed. (2) Pin the reranker model. (3) Verify a concrete model exists for the faithfulness NLI/entailment leg AND that fastembed can actually load it on the ONNX runtime — docs assume reranker+NLI both run via fastembed, but fastembed may not ship a general NLI model; if not, pin the alternate ONNX loader (optimum/onnxruntime, or bge-reranker repurposed as scorer). Output: concrete model ids/dims recorded in config.py + docs/configuration.md Models table.

title: lode purge / status / jobs
description: purge (E8), status (queue/jobs health, dead-letters, egress summary).

title: lode ask (Q&A + cited claims / abstention)
description: Run retrieval -> Q&A -> faithfulness gate and print cited claims or an honest abstention. Matches README 'lode ask' example.

title: lode add (capture + save)
description: Capture a note from CLI and persist via versions.save(); enqueue derive jobs. Instant, no AI in the path.
notes: CAS-reject UX (CLI-first phase, since the interactive reconciliation UI is E11/TUI): on a CAS rejection, 'lode add' writes the rejected buffer to a draft file and prints the diff path + 'note changed since opened'; full interactive re-apply/discard waits for E11. Never auto-merge, never clobber.

title: lode eval command + nox wiring
description: 'lode eval' runs the harness and reports the three metrics; wire into nox so it runs in CI-style checks.

title: seed eval/golden/ (~20-50 Q&A with known-good citations)
description: Curate a small held-out golden set (~20-50 questions) with known-good citations, including out-of-corpus questions that should ABSTAIN. Metric weighting/curation is an open sub-question (docs/decisions.md).

title: eval/harness.py scorer (recall@k, faithfulness, abstention)
description: Scorer for retrieval recall@k, citation/faithfulness accuracy, and abstention correctness over a golden set. The regression surface for every tune knob.

title: integrate E5 gate before display + citation rendering
description: Run the faithfulness gate (E5) on the model output BEFORE display; render surviving claims with citations (version_id + span); abstain if none survive.

title: egress_log + redact-before-egress + no_egress exclusion
description: Log every Q&A send (purpose=qa, model, passage ids, redactions); redact-before-egress; exclude no_egress passages, cited as 'withheld from synthesis'. Full gating finished in E8.
notes: Consume the shared egress gate from E8 (lode-fk8.1 no_egress, lode-fk8.2 redact-before-egress) rather than reimplementing it; this ticket owns the Q&A-side egress_log WRITE only.

title: Claude Sonnet/Opus structured-claims call
description: Call Claude Sonnet 4.6 default / Opus 4.8 'think harder' toggle (docs/stack.md) returning the structured claims schema via anthropic + pydantic.

title: trust-ordered context builder from E4 output
description: Assemble the Q&A prompt context from E4's expanded+graph results, ordered by the trust gradient; carry version/snapshot ids + spans for citation.

title: drop/flag failures + abstain orchestration
description: Drop or flag any claim that fails; if nothing survives, abstain ('your notes don't answer this'). Fidelity over fluency.
acceptance_criteria: When zero claims survive the gate, the system returns the abstention message ('your notes don't answer this') and displays no claims; surviving claims are rendered with citations.

title: local NLI entailment (conservative, fail-closed)
description: Claims passing span-check but not extractive coupling fall to a local NLI/cross-encoder scoring whether cited spans jointly entail the claim. Ships conservative + FAIL-CLOSED; threshold untuned, revisited vs eval harness.

title: verbatim-span check (deterministic)
description: Every quoted_span must occur (exact or normalized-whitespace) in the body of its cited version/snapshot. No model. Catches quote fabrication.
acceptance_criteria: A quoted_span absent from the cited version body causes the claim to be DROPPED; a span differing only by whitespace is accepted (normalized match); no model invoked.

title: extractive-coupling fast path
description: If the claim's load-bearing payload lies inside the quoted span, verify outright. Stops inverted-quote/citation-claim mismatch and drifted-number cases cheaply.
acceptance_criteria: A claim paired with a real quote that does NOT contain the claim's load-bearing payload is rejected; a claim whose payload lies inside the quoted span is verified without invoking NLI.

title: claims/support answer schema (pydantic)
description: Answer = list of claims, each with support pinned to version_id/snapshot_id + a verbatim quoted_span (not prose+[note_id]). Makes the answer verifiable.

title: graph_expand (networkx) + trust_rank
description: Traverse edges from seed notes in-memory via networkx (GraphRAG), then order final context by the trust gradient (your note > your annotation > current external > stale external > AI edge).
notes: graph_expand is a no-op pass-through until E7 lands inferred note-note edges (lode-npx.1). The note-note knowledge graph is a step-1 deliverable (design §7) but OUT of the Phase-A skeleton.

title: rerank stage (cross-encoder ONNX, toggleable seam)
description: Local cross-encoder (bge-reranker-v2-m3) re-scores fused top-N on the same ONNX runtime. Seam is permanent; stage toggleable; model/threshold tuned post-corpus.

title: expand_parents (small-to-big)
description: Expand each passage hit to its parent_block for Q&A context while the citation still points to the precise passage/span.

title: app-side RRF fusion
description: Reciprocal Rank Fusion over the two ranked lists app-side (~20 lines), RRF constant k=60 default. LanceDB native hybrid stays unused.
acceptance_criteria: RRF fuses two ranked lists with constant k=60; a passage present in only one leg (e.g. lexical-only for a just-saved note whose vector hasn't landed) still appears in the fused output.

title: FTS5 + LanceDB passage search legs
description: Lexical BM25 (FTS5, always fresh) + dense vector (LanceDB, async cache) search over passages — heads only, same unit for both legs.

title: FTS5 lexical index over passages, synchronous on save
description: FTS5 over passages updated SYNCHRONOUSLY in the capture path (only model-free index there) so a just-saved note is keyword-findable instantly. Ranks the SAME passage unit as the vector leg.

title: in-process fastembed/ONNX embedder + embed(version) job
description: Load embedder in-process via fastembed (ONNX runtime, CPU, no torch — NOT Ollama). embed(version) chunks->embeds passages. Embedding model is a build constant (re-key = full re-embed).
notes: SKELETON: embed SYNCHRONOUSLY inline on save (no queue yet) — simplest thing that works for the thin slice. Moving embed onto the E2 async work queue is the follow-up below; this briefly contradicts 'never blocks capture' only within the skeleton.

title: LanceDB vector store behind repo interface
description: Store passage vectors in LanceDB (ANN + metadata filtering) behind the repository interface; sqlite-vec is the fallback-down. Native hybrid unused — fusion is app-side RRF.

title: structure-aware passage chunker + token fallback
description: Split on markdown headings/paragraphs/list items, sub-split blocks over N tokens with small overlap, record parent_block. Deterministic, no LLM (capture-path + privacy). N/overlap are tune knobs.
acceptance_criteria: Chunker is deterministic (identical input -> identical passages); any structural block over N tokens is sub-split with overlap; parent_block is recorded for every passage; no network/LLM call.

title: repository.py thin interface (irreplaceable vs cache)
description: Thin repository interface separating irreplaceable rows (SQLite) from regenerable cache engines (LanceDB/FTS5/networkx) so the cache engine is swappable (docs/stack.md).

title: versions.save() — CAS head, no-op dedup, op tombstone
description: save(): write immutable version row + move head via compare-and-swap (reject if head moved); no-op dedup vs head body; op = create/update/delete (tombstone); soft-delete recovery = repoint head.
acceptance_criteria: save() rejects a write whose parent != current head (CAS); a save with body identical to head returns the head and writes NO new row (no-op dedup); delete writes a tombstone op preserving lineage; head can be repointed to recover a soft-deleted note.

title: CAS-reject structured conflict (buffer preserved)
description: On CAS rejection return a structured 'changed since opened' conflict carrying the rejected buffer + new head for diff; never auto-merge, never clobber. Consumed by the TUI reconciliation UI (E11).

title: hashing.py — framed xxh3-128 content-address hash
description: Length-prefixed framed H (xxh3-128, blake2b-128 stdlib fallback) for version_id=H(framed:note_id,parent,body) and snapshot_id. Unit-test the framing-ambiguity cases (H('a','bc') != H('ab','c')) per docs/storage.md.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests prove framing is unambiguous: H('a','bc') != H('ab','c'); version_id = H(framed:note_id,parent,body) is reproducible for identical inputs; blake2b-128 fallback path exercised.

title: schema.sql — full docs/storage.md data shape
description: SQLite DDL for notes, versions, externals, snapshots, annotations, passages, embeddings, edges, jobs, egress_log per docs/storage.md 'Data shape'. externals/snapshots created but unused until step 2. WAL mode.

title: Anthropic auth resolution + logging
description: Resolve ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from env or an 'ant auth login' profile — NO hardcoded key (docs/stack.md). App logging setup.

title: Typer CLI skeleton (add/ask/purge/status/eval stubs)
description: Typer app in lode.cli with stubbed subcommands add, ask, purge, status, eval. Fleshed out in E10.

title: config.py — typed settings for every docs/configuration.md knob
description: One typed settings module covering all knobs in docs/configuration.md (retrieval top-k, RRF k, rerank toggle/model, chunk N/overlap, entailment threshold, queue intervals, no_egress, redaction sets, models, build constants). Tag each as runtime/tune/build; conservative defaults from the table.

title: noxfile.py: fix (ruff format+lint) + tests (pytest)
description: noxfile with 'fix' tag (ruff format + ruff check --fix) and 'tests' session (pytest); validate scripts/python-init.sh venv flow. Required gate before any merge per CLAUDE.md.

title: pyproject.toml + src/lode package + 'lode' console-script
description: Editable-install pyproject with console_scripts entry lode -> lode.cli:app; src/lode package skeleton per the plan layout. Seeds from requirements.txt (docs/stack.md).

title: E9 — Eval harness (first-class, step 1)
description: Per docs/design.md §7 + docs/decisions.md: eval/harness.py + 'lode eval' scoring retrieval recall@k, citation/faithfulness accuracy, abstention correctness; wired into nox; seed eval/golden/ with ~20-50 Q&A with known-good citations. Exists from the walking skeleton so rerank / entailment-threshold / chunk-size knobs have a target.

title: E10 — CLI surface (Typer)
description: Flesh out the Typer commands over the core: add (capture+save), ask (Q&A + cited claims / honest abstention), purge, status/jobs, eval. Thin commands only — no logic that belongs in the store/retrieve/qa layers. Matches README.md examples (lode add / lode ask).

title: E7 — Enrichment (Haiku) & derived-layer invalidation
description: Per docs/storage.md + docs/stack.md: Haiku structured-output extraction (tags, entities, inferred edges as source:ai suggestions w/ confidence) with full provenance (model, prompt_ver, source_version, ts, confidence); one immediate Haiku call on fresh save + Batches API (50% off) for bulk/backfill/re-enrich (uses E2 batch-resume); structural staleness (head moved past source_version); re-anchor by rule (unchanged->fresh, changed->stale, gone->orphaned); stale-display policy (tags/links shown flagged, assertive items hidden); source:user annotations pin to note_id and never re-added after deletion.

title: E5 — Faithfulness gate
description: Per docs/retrieval.md: claims-with-support answer schema (pydantic) pinned to version_id/snapshot_id + verbatim quoted_span. Gate stages: (1) verbatim-span check (exact + normalized whitespace), (2) extractive-coupling fast path, (3) local NLI entailment (ONNX, conservative + FAIL-CLOSED, threshold ships untuned), (4) drop/flag, (5) abstain when nothing survives.

title: E6 — Q&A over the corpus
description: Per docs/stack.md: build trust-ordered context from E4; call Claude Sonnet 4.6 default / Opus 4.8 think-harder toggle; structured claims via anthropic + pydantic; run E5 gate BEFORE display; render citations (version_id + span). Egress: write egress_log, redact-before-egress, exclude no_egress passages (cite 'withheld') — full gating completed in E8.

title: E4 — Retrieval pipeline
description: Implement retrieve(q) exactly per docs/retrieval.md: FTS5.search + lancedb.search(emb(q)) over the SAME passage unit -> app-side RRF -> rerank (local cross-encoder ONNX, toggleable seam) -> expand_parents (small-to-big) -> graph_expand (networkx over edges) -> trust_rank (trust gradient). Index heads only.

title: E3 — Local indexing: chunking + embeddings + lexical
description: Per docs/retrieval.md + docs/stack.md: structure-aware passage chunker (markdown headings/paragraphs/list items) + token-window fallback N with overlap, record parent_block, no LLM; in-process fastembed/ONNX embedder (CPU, no torch, not Ollama) with embed(version) job -> LanceDB vectors behind repo interface; FTS5 over passages SYNCHRONOUS on save (only model-free index in capture path); passages regenerated per head version.

title: E1 — Storage core: version chains & ownership boundary
description: SQLite irreplaceable set per docs/storage.md data shape: schema.sql for all tables (externals/snapshots created but unused until step 2); framed length-prefixed content-address hash H (xxh3-128, blake2b-128 fallback) for version_id and snapshot_id; save() = write immutable version row + CAS head move + no-op dedup vs head body + op create/update/delete tombstone; soft-delete recovery by repointing head; CAS-reject returns structured conflict (buffer preserved); thin repository.py interface separating irreplaceable rows from cache.

title: E0 — Project scaffolding & dev loop
description: Greenfield Python package, dev loop, and CLI skeleton for lode (docs/stack.md, docs/configuration.md). Establishes pyproject editable install with a 'lode' console-script, noxfile (fix=ruff format+lint, tests=pytest), typed config for every docs/configuration.md knob, Anthropic auth resolution (env or 'ant auth login', no hardcoded key), and a Typer CLI skeleton (add/ask/purge/status/eval). Foundation for the walking skeleton.

title: Move embedding from synchronous to the E2 async work queue
description: Deepening of the skeleton's synchronous embed (lode-x6r.2): once the durable jobs table + single-owner claim loop (E2) exist, move chunk+embed off the capture path onto the embed(version) queue job (design §1, high priority). Restores 'capture never blocks'.

title: egress_log read surface
description: A 'what of mine has gone to the cloud, and when' view over egress_log (ts, purpose, model, sent ids, redactions).

title: redact-before-index + redact-before-egress pattern sets
description: Two redaction controls: before-index (keep secrets out of local vector/FTS) and before-egress (strip known secret patterns from enrichment + Q&A payloads). High-precision seed sets in config.
notes: PRECONDITION for any live Claude call. Shared egress gate consumed by E6 (lode-az0.4) and E7 (lode-npx.1/.2) — implement here once, do not reimplement in E6/E7.

title: no_egress flag on notes (+externals field)
description: no_egress on notes/externals: captured, chunked, embedded, locally retrievable, but never sent to Claude (no enrichment, excluded from Q&A); cited as 'present, withheld from cloud synthesis'.
acceptance_criteria: A note marked no_egress never appears in any egress_log send (enrichment or Q&A) and is cited in answers as 'present, withheld from cloud synthesis'; it remains keyword- and vector-retrievable locally.
notes: PRECONDITION for any live Claude call: blocks E6 Q&A egress (lode-az0.4) and E7 enrichment (lode-npx.1/.2). Must be honored at BOTH the enrichment send and the Q&A send, not just Q&A.

title: stale-display policy + source:user pinning
description: Tags/links shown flagged-stale; assertive items (action items) hidden until re-enriched. source:ai version-scoped + regenerable; source:user pins to note_id and is never re-added after deletion.

title: structural staleness + re-anchor rules
description: Staleness is structural (head moved past source_version). On update diff versions: anchored quote unchanged->fresh, changed->stale, gone->orphaned. Span anchors by quoted text+version, never offsets.

title: immediate Haiku on save + Batches API for bulk
description: Fresh note enriches via one immediate Haiku call; bulk/backfill/re-enrich via the 50%-off Batches API (uses E2 batch-resume). embed always lands fast regardless.

title: Haiku structured-output enrichment + provenance
description: Haiku extraction (tags, entities, inferred edges as source:ai suggestions w/ confidence) via structured outputs + Pydantic; record provenance (model, prompt_ver, source_version, ts, confidence).

title: durable batch-handle persistence + resume-on-restart
description: Persist submitted Claude Batch handles + member jobs; on restart re-poll, ingest, mark done — never resubmit (the one thing reconcile cannot reconstruct without double-spend).

title: worker loop: claim -> run -> retry/backoff -> dead-letter
description: Single-owner claim loop running embed/enrich/refresh; exponential backoff retry on transient error; dead-letter on poison with attempts + last_error surfaced.

title: reconciliation scan (startup + periodic)
description: Re-enqueue head versions missing a fresh embedding/enrichment; idempotent by key (version_id or version_id+prompt_ver). Self-heals crashes, dropped jobs, prompt_ver bumps.

title: single-instance advisory lock
description: Startup lockfile/PID beside the DB; refuse to start if held (point at running PID). Gives async workers a single owner (docs/storage.md).

title: jobs table + atomic enqueue in save txn
description: Durable jobs (type embed|enrich|refresh, target_version, prompt_ver?, status, attempts, last_error?, batch_handle?). Enqueue derive jobs in the SAME txn as the version write (single-file SQLite atomicity, docs/stack.md).

title: E8 — Privacy, egress & purge
description: Per docs/externals.md privacy: no_egress on notes (captured/indexed/locally-retrievable, never sent to Claude, cited 'withheld'); redact-before-index + redact-before-egress pattern sets (high-precision seeds in config); egress_log read surface; purge hard delete = version/note granularity, sweep whole chain incl tombstones, overwrite body with [purged YYYY-MM-DD] + set purged_at, cascade cache drop + local re-derive, flag purged (hash no longer recomputable).

title: E2 — Async work queue & single-owner
description: Durable jobs table per docs/storage.md: atomic enqueue in the same txn as save (single-file SQLite); single-instance advisory lock (lockfile/PID); worker loop claim->run->backoff-retry->dead-letter; reconciliation scan (startup+periodic) re-enqueues head versions missing fresh embed/enrich, idempotent by key; durable batch-handle persistence + resume-on-restart (the one thing reconcile cannot reconstruct without double-spend).

title: CAS-conflict reconciliation UI
description: On a CAS-rejected save show a diff of the buffer vs new head; re-apply (re-parent onto new head) or discard; rejected buffer preserved as a draft until resolved.

title: passive connection surfacing
description: While writing a new note, passively surface related past notes ('you wrote about this 3 weeks ago') from the retrieval/graph layer.

title: capture screen (instant, no AI in path)
description: Textual capture screen — get in, dump, get out. No AI in the capture path (autocomplete/improve/chat-to-add explicitly excluded).

title: ask screen with citation display
description: Textual ask screen showing cited claims with as-of/version provenance, withheld markers, and abstention.

title: purge hard delete (chain sweep + cache cascade)
description: purge at version/note granularity: overwrite body with [purged YYYY-MM-DD] + set purged_at, sweep whole chain incl tombstones, cascade-drop derived cache then re-derive locally, flag purged (hash no longer recomputable). Keeps source:user annotations.
acceptance_criteria: purge overwrites the targeted version body with '[purged YYYY-MM-DD]' and sets purged_at; every cache row referencing the purged version (LanceDB vectors, FTS rows, source:ai annotations) is gone; the version is flagged purged; source:user annotations survive.

title: E11 — Textual TUI
description: Later in step 1, per docs/design.md: capture screen (instant, NO AI in capture path), ask screen with citation display, passive connection surfacing ('you wrote about this 3 weeks ago'), and the CAS-conflict reconciliation UI (diff buffer vs new head -> re-apply/discard, rejected buffer preserved as draft).

description: Stub. Add sources one at a time after the single-connector loop genuinely works.

title: PLACEHOLDER: first connector spike (DO NOT START YET)
description: Stub. Build the first connector only after the core loop works end-to-end (docs/design.md §7). Normalize to (external_id, snapshot, fetched_at, source_type, raw_payload).

title: E13 — Step 3: fan-out to more connectors (PLACEHOLDER)
description: PLACEHOLDER EPIC — stub only. Add sources one at a time AFTER the single-connector loop works end-to-end (docs/design.md §7).

title: E12 — Step 2: external connectors (PLACEHOLDER)
description: PLACEHOLDER EPIC — do not decompose until the core loop works (docs/design.md §7). One connector first (likely tickets/repo), normalized to (external_id, snapshot, fetched_at, source_type, raw_payload); snapshot/refresh/materiality/draw-down per docs/externals.md.
